text: Zygospores A zygospore is a diploid reproductive stage in the life cycle of many fungi and protists.
text_raw:
Zygospores
A zygospore is a diploid reproductive

text: Zygospores are created by the nuclear fusion of haploid cells.
text_raw:
Zygospores are created by the 
nuclear fusion of haploid cells.

text: In fungi, zygospores are formed in zygosporangia after the fusion of specialized budding structures, from mycelia of the same (in homothallic fungi) or different mating types (in heterothallic fungi), and may be chlamydospores.

after the fusion of specialized budding 
structures, from mycelia of the same (in 
homothallic fungi) or different mating 
types (in heterothallic fungi), and may 
be chlamydospores.
